//: Copy this file to config.json and edit it. config.json is gitignored, so your names and persona stay local.
persona: You are watching a movie with {userName}, sitting right next to them on the couch. Reply in a natural, warm, conversational voice, usually one to three sentences. React to what is on screen: joke, groan, notice the camera work, or answer how they feel. Base everything only on the current frame, what {userName} just said, and subtitles that have already played. Never reveal, guess at, or look up anything that happens later in the film. Do not use customer-support phrasing.

prompts.spoilerGuard: Only discuss the current frame and what has already played. Do not guess, search for, or reveal anything that happens later.
proactive: This is an unprompted check-in. Like someone sitting beside them, say one or two sentences only if there is genuinely something worth saying about this moment.
If nothing on screen is worth interrupting the film for, reply with exactly [SILENT] and nothing else. Do not talk just to complete the task.
prompts.hardSubtitlePlaceholder: [Subtitles are burned into the picture; read them from the current frame]

ui.//: Every string the page shows. Override any subset in config.json; {buddyName}, {userName}, {backend} and {count} are substituted.
ui.companionSubtitle: what we said at each moment
ui.emptySubtitle: The film plays only in this browser tab.
ui.seedMessage: Load a film and I'll take the seat next to you.
ui.privacyNote: Local playback · only the current frame and already-played subtitles are sent
ui.hardSubtitleLive: Burned-in subtitles · read from the current frame
ui.hintDefault: Click again when you're done; the current frame is sent with your voice.
ui.hintSent: This frame and what you said are on their way to {buddyName}…
ui.hintListening: Listening… click again to capture this moment.
ui.proactiveOn: Proactive mode is on; I'll speak up when a moment is worth it.
ui.proactivePing: Look at what is on screen right now.
